column1: # pk-photo-detect (page-kinds-three), 2026-10-14: Recogniser.isPhotograph measured by Tools/score-page-photo on the photographed sample
# (PK-PHOTO-SAMPLE-2026-10-14.tsv; an id ending x is the same image with its EXIF stripped, the same pixels; pdf ids carry their page)
# and the 152 pages of PAGE-KIND-2026-10-12.tsv. Result: 217 of 217 rows called as labelled: 58 photo rows (32 distinct images, 26
# of them also stripped), every one called on its pixels alone; 159 others, none. In-sample: the thresholds were set on these pages.
# Relabelled: s62 (Riesman 1954, book p16) is a camera photo, not a scan: each page is its own image at a different nominal dpi
# (370-600), page 1 exactly 1936x2592 (the iPad frame), cropped by FineReader; perspective toward the gutter, uneven warm light.
# As first labelled the criterion fails on it alone. Thin margins: s04 (1954 - Why p9, a colour booklet scan) passes the four
# main cues and is held out by the second test alone; photos at border 0.055 (>= 0.05), fall-off 0.064 (>= 0.06), cast 4.2 (>= 4).
